block.name: Test suite fixes — #194 (Agent Zero asyncio) + #196 (QuantumGraph flaky tolerances)
acceptance_criteria: #194: agent-zero pytest.ini created with asyncio_mode = auto
#196: test_many_random_phases_average tolerance widened — test passes reliably
#196: test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude tolerance widened — test passes reliably
Both QuantumGraph flaky tests pass on 3 consecutive runs (pytest -x)

never: Do NOT change any test logic — only widen tolerances or increase trial counts
Do NOT modify the Morphogenesis project
Do NOT touch any NeuroGraph or Praxis files
anti_drift: Surgical changes: two tolerance edits, one requirements.txt line addition, one pytest.ini creation

steps.description: Read agent-zero requirements.txt to find where to add pytest-asyncio
#194 — Create agent-zero/pytest.ini with asyncio_mode = auto so @pytest.mark.asyncio tests are discovered without explicit marking
Read test_many_random_phases_average to confirm exact tolerance expression

#196 — Widen test_many_random_phases_average tolerance from 0.5*classical to classical (100%). With n=100 random phases and seed 42 this occasionally exceeds 50% deviation; 100% is still meaningful (within one classical unit) and statistically robust.

params.command: python3 -c "p='/home/josh/QuantumGraph/quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py'; s=open(p).read(); assert '0.5 * classical' in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace('assert abs(quantum - classical) < 0.5 * classical','assert abs(quantum - classical) < classical',1)); print('UPDATED')"

steps.description: Read test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude to confirm exact tolerance expression

#196 — Widen test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude absolute tolerance from 0.03 to 0.05. Expected 25% frequency with 10k trials has std dev ~0.004 — 0.03 is 7-sigma but 0.05 adds headroom against RNG edge cases.

params.command: python3 -c "p='/home/josh/QuantumGraph/quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py'; s=open(p).read(); assert 'abs=0.03' in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace('pytest.approx(0.25, abs=0.03)','pytest.approx(0.25, abs=0.05)',1)); print('UPDATED')"

steps.description: Run the two previously-flaky QuantumGraph tests three times to confirm stable

params.command: cd /home/josh/QuantumGraph && python3 -m pytest quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py::TestMixedInterference::test_many_random_phases_average quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py::TestCollapseEdgeCases::test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude -v 2>&1 | tail -10 && python3 -m pytest quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py::TestMixedInterference::test_many_random_phases_average quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py::TestCollapseEdgeCases::test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && python3 -m pytest quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py::TestMixedInterference::test_many_random_phases_average quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py::TestCollapseEdgeCases::test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo 'ALL 3 RUNS PASSED'

steps.description: Confirm: pytest-asyncio in agent-zero requirements.txt, agent-zero/pytest.ini exists with asyncio_mode=auto, both QuantumGraph tolerance tests pass on 3 consecutive runs.
